answer: Sybil resistance via a marble-slab cost gate: each agent identity is minted onto a heavy on-chain registry slab priced above the epoch reward. New agents earn voting weight only after surviving a plume of random audit challenges for a full cycle. Colluders who split one stake across many marble slabs are caught because all identities sharing a funding path lose their slabs together, and the seized value flows back as nectar rewards to the auditors who exposed them, making sybil attacks always more expensive than honest earning.
